original.target_description: Experiment 2 three-condition auditory-flanker RT analyses located, but requested congruency × flanker-modality interaction is not identified. Experiment 2 has only auditory flankers, not a flanker-modality factor.

n.sample_role: Unresolved target; candidate Experiment 2 sample is 36 participants (replacements reported), not assigned as analytic N for an unidentified modality-interaction model.
n.exclusions: Candidate Experiment 2: two participants replaced for >10% errors; RTs outside 150–1500 ms (0.05% and 0.88%) and incorrect-response trials excluded. No sample count derived from degrees of freedom.
n.location: Experiment 2, Method / Participants; Results and discussion, opening paragraph
n.quote: A fresh sample of 36 participants was recruited (24 females and 12 males, mean age 24.83 years). Two participants were replaced because they made more than 10% errors. ... As in the previous experiment, trials with RTs outside the range 150–1500 ms (0.05% and 0.88%) and incorrect responses were excluded from all RT analyses.

notes: Identity independently checked: canonical text is a full Springer primary research article, A bimodal extension of the Eriksen flanker task, by Rolf Ulrich, Laura Prislan, and Jeff Miller; DOI 10.3758/s13414-020-02150-8. Online publication 11 November 2020 and volume 83, pages 790–799 (2021) agree with the supplied reference. Includes Methods, Results, Discussion, references and article metadata; not an abstract-only excerpt or preregistration. No PDF supplied, so PDF page 6 cannot be visually verified; section and figure locators are used. Only assigned unfinished fields evaluated; all other fields are placeholders. Target ambiguity: the description additionally requests an interaction of congruency and flanker modality, while the located Experiment 2 reports one-way congruency ANOVAs and no modality factor. The mean RT ANOVA (F(2,70) = 47.05, η² = 0.57) and the Vincentized distribution analysis (congruency F(2,70) = 45.24, η² = 0.56; percentile × congruency F(18,630) = 2.26, p = .08, η² = 0.06) are distinct candidates; none is a congruency × modality interaction. Candidate N = 36 is supported by the Participants statement and replacement description, but is retained only as candidate evidence for parent field-scope review. Recruitment and analytic roles are not silently equated. No N arithmetic, df-derived N, or effect conversion performed.
